segments.text: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose.
Cellular respiration releases energy from glucose and commonly produces ATP, carbon dioxide, and water.

Diffusion is the net movement of particles from higher concentration to lower concentration.
Osmosis is water movement across a selectively permeable membrane toward higher solute concentration.

Causes of industrialization included accessible capital, labor, natural resources, and expanding markets.
Urbanization accelerated as factory employment drew workers toward rapidly growing cities.

A primary source is direct evidence created during the period being studied.
A secondary source interprets or analyzes evidence from primary sources.
Chronology orders events by when they occurred so changes and causes can be traced.
Corroboration compares independent sources to identify agreement, conflict, and missing context.
Historical context connects an event to the social, political, and economic conditions around it.
Una fuente primaria es evidencia directa creada durante el periodo que se estudia.
La corroboración compara fuentes independientes para encontrar acuerdos y contradicciones.
Newton's first law: an object maintains its state of motion unless acted on by a net external force.
Newton's second law: net force equals mass multiplied by acceleration.
Newton's third law: interacting objects exert equal-magnitude forces in opposite directions.
Momentum equals mass times velocity and is a vector quantity.
Kinetic energy depends on one half of mass multiplied by velocity squared.
Gravitational potential energy near Earth equals mass times gravitational field strength times height.
A transverse wave oscillates perpendicular to its direction of travel.
Frequency is the number of complete wave cycles passing a point each second.
La fuerza neta es igual a la masa multiplicada por la aceleración.
La frecuencia indica cuántos ciclos completos pasan por un punto cada segundo.
